admin.settings.assessment_points_hint: When enabled, users can open a points badge in their account to review total points and where they were earned.
admin.settings.auto_logout_enable_hint: When enabled, all user sessions are invalidated once per day at the configured hour.
admin.settings.auto_mass_logout_intro: Schedule a daily automatic logout of all users at a specific hour. When triggered, every active session is invalidated and users must sign in again. Useful for enforcing daily re-authentication policies.
admin.settings.bot_protection_enable: Enable bot protection on authentication forms
admin.settings.bot_protection_hint: When enabled, the login, sign-up, and setup forms include a hidden honeypot field and a timing check. Automated bots that fill hidden fields or submit forms too quickly are silently rejected. No external service is used. Recommended: keep this enabled.
admin.settings.canvas_open_access_enable: Allow all users to view and edit any canvas regardless of role
admin.settings.canvas_open_access_hint: When enabled, any logged-in user can view and edit any canvas. Disable to use role-based canvas access controls.
admin.settings.canvas_public_access_enab: Show public canvases to anonymous visitors when public access is enabled
admin.settings.canvas_public_access_hint: Anonymous visitors can only view canvases whose visibility is Public. Creating, editing, importing, exporting, and sharing still require an account.
admin.settings.canvas_view_access_hint: Controls which roles can access the canvas feature globally. Users without this access level can still be invited to individual canvases via canvas-level sharing.
admin.settings.canvas_write_access: Who can create and edit canvases
admin.settings.canvas_write_access_hint: Controls who can create canvases and edit canvas data globally. Canvas creators can additionally grant edit access to individual users through canvas-level sharing, regardless of this setting.
admin.settings.chat_attachments_hint: Allow users to attach files to chat messages.
admin.settings.chat_cleanup_hint: When enabled, old messages and attachments are deleted automatically on the configured schedule. The DM and Group retention settings below control what gets deleted.
admin.settings.cleanup_frequency_hint: How often the cleanup runs. Default: every 7 days (weekly).
admin.settings.cleanup_hour_hint: Hour of day (in site timezone) when cleanup runs. Default: 3 (3 AM).
admin.settings.contribution_approval_hin: When enabled, read-only users (role='user') can propose edits to wiki pages. Proposed edits must be approved by an admin before being applied. Data is preserved when disabled: re-enabling restores existing contributions.
admin.settings.contribution_quota_auto_a: Auto-approve contribution quota requests up to
Finite requests at or below this value are approved immediately. Set to 0 to disable; unlimited requests always require review.
admin.settings.contribution_quota_defaul: Default Max Pending Contributions Per User

admin.settings.contributor_leaderboard_h: When enabled, all logged-in users can view the contributor leaderboard with search, date range filters, streak tracking, and CSV export.
admin.settings.daily_attachment_limit_hi: Maximum number of file attachments each user can send per day across all chats.
admin.settings.default_theme_mode_hint: New visitors and users without a personal override will use this theme by default.
admin.settings.dm_allow_creation: Allow Users to Create New DMs
admin.settings.dm_allow_creation_hint: If disabled, only existing DM conversations can be used.
admin.settings.dm_attachment_retention_h: Keep DM attachments for this many days. Messages remain intact.
admin.settings.dm_auto_clear_attachments: Delete DM attachments to save disk space (recommended).

admin.settings.dm_enable_hint: Allow users to send private one-on-one messages.
admin.settings.dm_message_retention_hint: Keep DM messages for this many days. Set to 0 to keep forever.
admin.settings.docs_bypass_slowdown: Bypass deletion slowdown for documentation pages
admin.settings.docs_bypass_slowdown_hint: When enabled, documentation pages are deleted instantly regardless of the Deletion Slowdown plugin.
admin.settings.docs_download_zip_hint: Download the same content the Spawn button creates as a ZIP archive of Markdown files. Edit them locally and upload through Bulk Markdown Import to ship a wiki-specific guide.
admin.settings.draft_expiration_hint: How long before unused drafts are automatically deleted. Set to 0 to disable (drafts persist indefinitely). This is separate from the stale draft cleanup (30-day retention).
admin.settings.fallback_language_hint: Used when the selected site language is disabled or unavailable.
admin.settings.favicon_enable_hint: When disabled, the browser default favicon is used.
admin.settings.group_allow_creation: Allow Users to Create New Groups

admin.settings.group_attachment_retentio: Keep group attachments for this many days. Messages remain intact.
admin.settings.group_auto_clear_attachme: Delete group attachments to save disk space (recommended).
admin.settings.group_auto_clear_hint: Automatically delete group messages older than the retention period.
admin.settings.group_auto_clear_requires: Enable the Chat Cleanup plugin in Admin → Plugins to configure automatic deletion for group messages and attachments.
admin.settings.group_chat_hint: Allow users to create and participate in group conversations.
admin.settings.group_message_retention_h: Keep group messages for this many days. Set to 0 to keep forever.
admin.settings.kanban_open_access_enable: Allow all users to view and edit any kanban board regardless of role
admin.settings.kanban_open_access_hint: When enabled, any logged-in user can view and edit any kanban board. Disable to use role-based kanban access controls.
admin.settings.kanban_public_access_enab: Show public kanban boards to anonymous visitors when public access is enabled
admin.settings.kanban_public_access_hint: Anonymous visitors can only view boards whose board visibility is Public. Creating, editing, importing, exporting, and sharing still require an account.
admin.settings.kanban_view_access: Who can view the kanban board
admin.settings.kanban_view_access_hint: Controls which roles can access the kanban feature globally. Users without this access level can still be invited to individual boards via board-level sharing.
admin.settings.kanban_write_access: Who can create and edit boards, columns, and tickets
admin.settings.kanban_write_access_hint: Controls who can create boards, add/edit columns, and manage tickets globally. Board owners can additionally grant write access to individual users through board-level sharing, regardless of this setting.
admin.settings.login_app_selector_hint: After logging in, users are shown a page where they can choose to enter the Wiki, Canvas, or Kanban app. Only apps that are enabled and accessible will appear.
admin.settings.logout_hour_hint: Hour of the day (0 = midnight, 12 = noon) at which the automatic logout runs. Uses the server's configured time zone.
admin.settings.maintenance_enable_hint: When enabled, all non-admin users are logged out and cannot access the wiki. A maintenance page is shown in place of the normal login screen; administrators can still sign in from /admin.
admin.settings.maintenance_message_hint: This message is shown to visitors while maintenance mode is active.
admin.settings.maintenance_message_place: Enter a message to display on the maintenance page…
admin.settings.manage_languages_hint: Upload, download, edit or delete custom language packs. Built-in English and Italian are protected.
admin.settings.markdown_export_hint: When enabled, editors can download wiki pages as .md files with YAML front-matter.
admin.settings.max_message_length_hint: Maximum length of a single chat message.
admin.settings.max_video_size_hint: Maximum file size for directly hosted videos uploaded via Custom Pages. Applies to the Hosted Video content type. Valid range: 1–2048 MB.
admin.settings.no_protected_pages: There are no protected pages right now.
admin.settings.open_signup_enable: Allow sign-up without an invite code
admin.settings.open_signup_hint: When enabled, new users can create accounts without needing an invite code. Existing users are not affected. This is not recommended for normal operation: BananaWiki is designed as a private, invite-only wiki. Use this only for special or temporary cases (e.g. onboarding events, open enrolment periods).
admin.settings.open_signup_until_hint: If set, open sign-up will automatically revert to invite-only after this date and time (UTC). Users who signed up while the code was not required will keep their accounts. Leave empty to keep open sign-up on until manually disabled.
admin.settings.page_governance_hint: Bundled editorial controls: page reservations, page protection, and contribution approval. Toggle the master plugin from Admin → Plugins to disable all three subsystems at once.
admin.settings.page_protection_hint: When enabled, editors can protect a page and only that user can edit it. Other admins can remove protection from this settings page only after a 72-hour waiting period.
admin.settings.page_reservations_hint: When enabled, editors can reserve pages before making destructive changes. Non-admins are blocked from editing reserved pages, while administrators can still override reservations with a clear warning.
admin.settings.pdf_export_hint: When enabled, users with the Export Pages as PDF permission can download wiki pages and page history revisions as PDF files. The permission is disabled for all roles by default and must be granted individually through the custom permissions system.
admin.settings.profile_chart_hint: Controls the GitHub-style contribution chart shown on profile pages.
admin.settings.profile_group_badges_enab: Allow users to display group memberships on profiles
admin.settings.profile_group_badges_hint: When enabled, users can choose which chat groups to show as badges on their public profile page. Badges are hidden by default and must be toggled on individually by each user.
admin.settings.public_mode_hint: When enabled, the wiki is publicly accessible without authentication. Visitors can read pages but cannot create, edit, or delete anything. Users still need to sign in for full access. This is not recommended for normal operation: BananaWiki is designed as a private, invite-only wiki. Use this only for special or temporary cases.
admin.settings.public_mode_placeholder: Enter a message to display to visitors who are not signed in…
admin.settings.public_mode_show_message: Show a message to non-authenticated visitors
admin.settings.public_mode_until_hint: If set, public access will automatically revert to private after this date and time (UTC). Leave empty to keep public access on until manually disabled.
admin.settings.quota_request_cooldown_hi: After a quota request is cancelled, approved, or denied, users must wait this many hours before submitting a new request. Set to 0 to disable.
admin.settings.reservation_cooldown_hint: How long the reserving user must wait before reserving the same page again after a release or expiry. Default: 24 hours.
admin.settings.reservation_quota_auto_ap: Auto-approve reservation quota requests up to
Finite requests at or below this value are approved immediately. Set to 0 to disable; unlimited requests always require review.
admin.settings.reservation_quota_default: Default Max Concurrent Reserved Pages Per User
Default reservation quota for users who have not received an approved quota increase. Default: 5 pages.
admin.settings.reservation_timeout_hint: How long a page stays reserved before the reservation expires automatically. Default: 48 hours.
admin.settings.server_restart_confirm: Restart the server now? Active sessions will briefly drop while gunicorn restarts.
admin.settings.server_restart_intro: Fully restart this wiki's nginx, gunicorn and Flask stack. Sibling wikis on the same host are unaffected. A {seconds}-second cooldown is enforced between restarts.
admin.settings.session_limit_enable: Limit users to one active session
admin.settings.session_limit_hint: When enabled, signing in from a new device or tab invalidates any previous session for that user. This prevents users from being logged in on multiple devices or browser tabs simultaneously.
admin.settings.sidebar_apps_order_hint: Drag or reorder the sidebar app links. The first item appears at the top of the sidebar apps section.
admin.settings.site_language_hint: Default interface language for new visitors and users who have not set a personal preference.
admin.settings.site_migration_intro: Export or import all site data for backup and migration purposes.
admin.settings.suspended_account_deletio: Allow suspended users to delete their own account
When enabled, suspended users can permanently delete their account from the suspension page after confirming their password. Protected accounts and the last administrator cannot be deleted.
admin.settings.theme_defaults_intro: Set the site-wide default theme and both color palettes. Users can still override these from their customization settings.
admin.settings.theme_export_hint: Downloads the current default mode plus dark and light palettes as a portable .bwtheme file.
admin.settings.theme_import_hint: Restores only theme settings. BananaWiki does not store or host theme libraries.
admin.settings.time_zone_hint: Dates and times are stored in UTC and displayed in the selected time zone. Daylight saving time (DST) transitions and leap years are handled automatically.

admin.settings.trigger_categories_intro: Enable backup for each priority category:
admin.settings.tts_auto_enable: Automatically generate audio when pages are created or updated
admin.settings.tts_auto_hint: When on, BananaWiki detects each page's language and queues local audio synthesis in the background after every normal page save. Bulk imports still suppress automatic fan-out.
admin.settings.tts_gpu_auth_token_hint: Shared secret for the GPU server. Leave unchanged to keep current token.
admin.settings.tts_gpu_enable_hint: When enabled, TTS synthesis is sent to a remote GPU server. Local Piper is used as fallback if the GPU server is unreachable.
admin.settings.tts_gpu_platform_managed: These settings come from the server environment (BW_TTS_REMOTE_GPU_URL, BW_TTS_REMOTE_GPU_AUTH_TOKEN and BW_TTS_REMOTE_GPU_TIMEOUT), not from this form. On a hosted wiki, ask the platform admin to change them. On a wiki installed with banana install, the server administrator sets them in config/app.env.
admin.settings.tts_gpu_timeout_hint: Maximum seconds to wait for the GPU server before falling back to local Piper.
admin.settings.tts_gpu_url_hint: Private network URL of the GPU TTS server (e.g. Tailscale IP).
admin.settings.tts_languages_all_hint: Text-to-Speech uses local Piper voice models. BananaWiki includes defaults for every Piper language it can map, and admins can add more local models with BW_TTS_PIPER_VOICE_MAP.
admin.settings.tts_languages_hint: Pick which text-to-speech languages are available on this wiki. Pages are auto-detected via langdetect and synthesized in whichever enabled language matches. If detection fails or the detected language is disabled, the first enabled language (English by default) is used as the fallback.
admin.settings.tts_mode_auto_save_hint: New and edited pages are queued after normal page saves. Bulk imports still suppress automatic fan-out.
admin.settings.tts_mode_on_demand_hint: Readers generate missing audio from the page button. Existing audio refreshes only when that page is edited. Bulk imports do not queue TTS.
admin.settings.tts_panel_enable: Show "Listen to this page" panel on wiki pages
admin.settings.tts_panel_hint: When enabled, an in-page panel lets readers request missing audio and play cached page audio. Audio that already exists cannot be regenerated from the page button.
admin.settings.tts_performance_mode_hint: Efficient uses fast synthesis with lower resource usage. Auto picks quality based on your hardware. High quality uses full-quality synthesis for best audio fidelity.
admin.settings.tts_public_enable: Show TTS to public visitors when public access is enabled
admin.settings.tts_public_hint: When public access mode is on, visitors who are not signed in can see the player and request missing audio from the page button. Clearing audio still requires an admin account.
admin.settings.upload_allowed_hint: Enter extensions without dots, separated by commas (e.g. pdf, docx, png, mp4). Leave empty to use the built-in default set.
admin.settings.upload_allowed_placeholde: Leave empty to use defaults (pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, txt, md, csv, png, jpg, gif, mp4, zip, …)
admin.settings.upload_blocked_hint: Enter extensions to block, separated by commas. Dangerous system extensions (.exe, .bat, .dll, etc.) are always blocked regardless of this list.
admin.settings.upload_max_size_hint: Maximum file size for page attachments and Kanban attachments (1–2048 MB, default 100).
admin.settings.upload_mode_hint: Whitelist: Only listed extensions are accepted (safest). Blacklist: Everything except listed extensions is accepted. Allow all: All file types are accepted (dangerous executables like .exe, .bat, .dll are always blocked regardless).
admin.settings.upload_settings_intro: Configure which file types are allowed for page attachments, Kanban ticket attachments, and chat attachments. Image uploads (wiki page content) always use a fixed allowlist for security.
admin.settings.wiki_docs_intro: Spawn a BananaWiki category with built-in documentation pages. If documentation already exists, it will be deleted and recreated with fresh content.

api_service.docs.auth_description: All API endpoints (except /api/v1/status) require a valid Bearer token in the Authorization header:
api_service.docs.bp_keep_secret_desc: Treat API tokens like passwords. The raw token is shown only once at creation.
api_service.docs.bp_monitor_desc: Regularly check the audit log in Admin → API Service for unusual activity.
api_service.docs.bp_rate_limits_desc: The API enforces per-user rate limits (default 60 req/min, 120 for admins).

api_service.docs.description: Guide to the BananaWiki Unified REST API.
api_service.docs.intro: Use the BananaWiki API to manage your wiki programmatically: users, pages, categories, settings, and more. Every action available through the web interface is also available through the API.
api_service.docs.safeguard_account: A token stops working while its account has to change its password or finish onboarding. Changing a password through the API revokes every API token of that account.
api_service.docs.safeguard_bulk: A bulk request handles up to 100 pages or 20 users, and a request body can be up to 16 MB.
api_service.docs.safeguard_maintenance: During maintenance only administrator tokens keep working. Other tokens receive 503.
api_service.docs.safeguard_pages: Pages follow the editor's limits: up to 1,000,000 characters of content, titles and slugs of up to 200 characters, and slugs normalised as the editor makes them. Deleting a page needs the page.delete permission.
api_service.docs.safeguard_scopes: Only administrator accounts can hold the admin, settings and users scopes. The banana mode endpoints need an administrator account as well as the admin scope.
api_service.docs.safeguard_settings: PUT /api/v1/settings accepts the settings of the admin settings page, with the same checks and limits. Settings the wiki or the hosting platform maintain, remote GPU settings and secrets are refused with 403. Invalid values are refused with 400, and a refused request saves nothing.
api_service.docs.scope_admin: Full admin access (view tokens, audit log)
api_service.docs.scopes_description: Tokens are limited by their selected scopes and read/write permissions, including tokens owned by administrators. Account permissions are checked separately.
api_service.docs.service_unavailable: API service disabled, or maintenance mode for tokens of non-admin accounts
api_service.docs.step1: Ask your admin to enable the API Service plugin in Admin → Plugins.
api_service.docs.step2: Go to Settings → API Tokens and create a token with your desired scopes.
api_service.docs.step3: Use the token in the Authorization: Bearer <token> header.
